cat > /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/eval_v8b_ss_s123.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# v8b-SS s123 eval: Base vs v8b-SS-s123, TF + AR, GAR-ours + GAR-Dongre
set -euo pipefail

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/turn_residual_gating

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12
EVAL_SCRIPT=src/eval_phase2_gar.py
CONV_PATH=data/ultrachat_eval_heldout.json
OUT_ROOT=runs/eval_v8b_ss_s123
SS_CKPT=checkpoints/tg_v8b_ss_s123/epoch_2

# ── Checkpoint verification ────────────────────────────────
[ -d "$SS_CKPT/lora" ] || { echo "ERROR: LoRA dir not found at $SS_CKPT/lora"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SS_CKPT/gate_params.pt" ] || { echo "ERROR: gate_params.pt not found at $SS_CKPT/gate_params.pt"; exit 1; }
echo "v8b-SS s123 checkpoint: $SS_CKPT"

mkdir -p "$OUT_ROOT"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Part 1: Teacher-Forced GAR (heldout conversations)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

echo "========== [TF 1/4] Base + GAR-ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type none \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_base_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [TF 2/4] Base + GAR-Dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type none \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_base_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [TF 3/4] v8b-SS s123 + GAR-ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$SS_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_ss_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [TF 4/4] v8b-SS s123 + GAR-Dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$SS_CKPT" \
  --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/tf_ss_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Part 2: Autoregressive GAR (model-generated conversations)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

echo "========== [AR 1/4] Base + GAR-ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type none \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_base_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [AR 2/4] Base + GAR-Dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type none \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_base_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [AR 3/4] v8b-SS s123 + GAR-ours =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$SS_CKPT" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_ss_ours" \
  --gar-variant ours \
  --gate-profile

echo "========== [AR 4/4] v8b-SS s123 + GAR-Dongre =========="
$PYTHON $EVAL_SCRIPT \
  --gate-type threadgate \
  --checkpoint-dir "$SS_CKPT" \
  --output-dir "$OUT_ROOT/ar_ss_dongre" \
  --gar-variant dongre \
  --gate-profile

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Part 3: PPL Summary
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

echo ""
echo "========== PPL Summary =========="
$PYTHON -c "
import json, glob, os
root = '$OUT_ROOT'
for mode in ['tf', 'ar']:
    print(f'--- {mode.upper()} ---')
    for name in ['base_ours', 'base_dongre', 'ss_ours', 'ss_dongre']:
        d = os.path.join(root, f'{mode}_{name}')
        for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(d, '*gar*.json'))):
            data = json.load(open(f))
            ppl = data.get('avg_ppl', data.get('ppl', 'N/A'))
            print(f'  {mode}_{name}: avg_ppl={ppl}')
            break
"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Summary
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "v8b-SS s123 eval complete"
echo "================================================================"
echo "Checkpoint: $SS_CKPT"
echo "Results in: $OUT_ROOT/"
echo ""
echo "Key comparisons:"
echo "  TF GAR gap:   tf_base_ours vs tf_ss_ours"
echo "  AR GAR gap:   ar_base_ours vs ar_ss_ours"
echo "  TF-AR gap:    tf_ss_ours vs ar_ss_ours  (training-inference gap)"
echo "  Dongre:       tf_ss_dongre vs ar_ss_dongre"
echo "  PPL:          check avg_ppl in each *_gar.json"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/turn_residual_gating/scripts/eval_v8b_ss_s123.sh
